items.summary: Canva 进一步深入人工智能领域，推出了图像生成模型，与 OpenAI、微软和谷歌的图像生成模型直接竞争。该模型名为 Canva Craft，采用两阶段架构，可以在生成图像之前规划设计，从而实现“更高的精度、一致性和控制”，根据 […]

items.title: Canva has entered the frontier AI model race, and its first model is already near the top. It's first in-house image model made it the second-best (on DesignArena) lab in image generation, with only OpenAI ahead of it.…
